\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[
    width=8cm,
    height=5.5cm,
    xlabel={$k$},
    xmin=0,

    legend style={at={(1.03,0.5)},anchor=west},

    \addplot[draw=red, densely dotted] table [x=k, y=gm_e, col sep=comma] {../../julia/accelerated.csv};

    \addplot[draw=blue, thick] table [x=k, y=agm, col sep=comma] {../../julia/accelerated.csv};
    \addlegendentry{AGM}
    \addplot[draw=blue, densely dotted] table [x=k, y=agm_e, col sep=comma] {../../julia/accelerated.csv};
    \addlegendentry{AGM bound}

  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
